tasks.label: Patch interactiveShell.py for Windows
args: if [[ $(uname -s) == MINGW* ]]; then sed -i "s/^[[:space:]]*import pty/#import pty/" "${workspaceFolder}/host/raft/framework/plugins/ut_raft/interactiveShell.py" && sed -i "s/^[[:space:]]*import fcntl/#import fcntl/" "${workspaceFolder}/host/raft/framework/plugins/ut_raft/interactiveShell.py"; fi
